messages:
hana.marketing: Need a compact visual pack for the launch landing + webinar. Scope: 2 hero tiles (1200x630, 800x800), 1 simplified SVG diagram (latency vs cost with 3 labeled levers), 2 email header sizes. 48hr turnaround if possible.

omar.design: We can take this. Confirming exports: SVG (diagram, text as vectors), PNG @2x for tiles, Figma components with token usage. Any priority?

nate.pm: Prioritize diagram + long hero first. Diagram should call out batching, KV cache, quantization with simple icons and short captions. Use Redwood palette only.

zoe.content: Copy locked. Two headline variants in figma comments. I added alt-text drafts. Avoid phrase "full production" per legal.

legal-bot: Note: the trademarked phrase "Redwood Serving" requires approval. Recommend neutral phrasing as fallback.

omar.design: Timeline: wireframes in 12h, first comps in 30h, final exports in 48h. Will create dark-mode social variant and a logo-free partner variant.

figma-bot: File created by omar.design \u2014 5 frames added, comments enabled.

hana.marketing: Thanks. Please include a one-paragraph usage note and a tiny PNG sprite with the three icons for docs. Tag me when first comps are ready.

omar.design: Will do. Posting frames shortly and tagging reviewers.
